questions.question_hindi:

III. धारा 6(3) के तहत स्थानांतरित आवेदन: स्थानांतरण करने वाले प्राधिकरण को मिलने की मूल तारीख से 35 दिन।

questions.question_english:
Review the following statements regarding the time limit for responding to an RTI application:
I. Normal application: 30 days.
II. Application involving life and liberty: 48 hours.
III. Application transferred under Section 6(3): 35 days from the original date of receipt by the transferring authority.
IV. Application submitted to APIO: 35 days. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?

I, II, and IV only
II, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: I, II, and IV only Standard RTI applications require a 30-day response, while life and liberty matters mandate 48 hours. Applications submitted via Assistant Public Information Officers allow 35 days. However, transferred applications under Section 6(3) require response within 30 days from transfer receipt, not 35 days from the original submission date.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: केवल I, II और IV। स्रोत में इस प्रक्रिया के लिए दी गई वैधानिक समय-सीमा ही सही विकल्प निर्धारित करती है।

questions.question_english: Select the incorrect statement regarding the Right to Information Act, 2005:

An applicant making an RTI request must submit an affidavit swearing to their Indian citizenship.

questions.question_english: Which option among the following is considered “fiduciary relationship” exempting information under Section 8(1)(e) of the RTI Act?

questions.question_english: A Principal of a Directorate of Education school receives an RTI application requesting a copy of the Annual Confidential Report (ACR) of another teacher in the school. Disclose the ACR in full as it constitutes an official public record held by a public authority.

Such records are protected from disclosure to third parties unless a larger public interest is conclusively demonstrated by the applicant seeking access.
